items.item_text: Demonstrated customer service experience in a professional setting
Experience working in a healthcare, medical office, or outpatient clinic setting
Experience working in mental health
Experience with electronic health record (EHR) systems
Experience supporting high-volume patient-facing operations

The Department of Psychiatry is seeking to hire a Front Desk Administrative Support to join our UCLA Medical Psychology Assessment Clinic (MPAC), a specialty clinic that provides comprehensive psychological and neurological assessments for children and adults with neurodevelopment, neurological, and psychiatric conditions, including ADHD, learning disabilities, epilepsy, brain injury, depression, anxiety, and bipolar disorders. Key responsibilities:
Greet, check in, and assist patients, visitors, and referring providers
Schedule, confirm, and coordinate patient appointments
Verify insurance and registration information
Answer incoming calls and respond to patient inquiries
Support providers and clinic staff with administrative tasks
Maintain accurate patient records and ensure confidentiality
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of basic psychiatric terminology
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
Knowledge of medical terminology
Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
Familiarity with insurance verification, referral, and appointment scheduling
Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgement when handling sensitive information
Ability to work effectively and support the clinic’s diverse patient population
